task.title: Changing the type of parental benefits ― Extended to standard

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a revised registration number exists for the issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 2.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 60 - Rejected transaction / or situation not otherwise listed that must be processed via purge and recreate .
Remarks Line 1: Type “Change from extended to standard parental benefits.”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change to CT 14, APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX].”
Remarks line 3: Type “Natural/Adoption Code [X], NO-CR (if requested by the client), WP deferral (type “yes” if required or “rescind” if it was deferred in error).”
Remarks line 4: Type “Rescind the extended parental benefits flag.”
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 97 - Internal adjustment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Special benefits approved (3046) .
Overpayment Messages (2452): Select Possibility of an overpayment .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .
If an N-00-00-00 has previously been sent for this PW, select This letter replaces or Footnote (2365) .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI corresponding to the change request:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI.
If no, no further action is required.
